Navigate Commodities monitors the movement & consumption of dry bulk commodities over land & sea using the most powerful technologies available.

We help commodity professionals identify real-world opportunities by revealing company-specific real-time trade and smelting activity.

Name: SpaceComputer | Orbital Root of Trust
Description:
SpaceComputer is building a satellite-based distributed network and open settlement layer for confidential smart contracts: A space-native compute layer where trust is rooted beyond Earth.

Our mission is to create physically-verifiable, tamper-proof computation in orbit. By leveraging the isolation and resilience of the space environment, SpaceComputer establishes a new cryptographic trust model that is independent from Earth-based infrastructure and censorship.

Designed and Engineered in Singapore.

Name: OnyX Space
Description:
OnyX Space offers all-in-one solutions with access from multiple Earth observation (EO) satellite constellations to turnkey geospatial solutions.

Exclusive access to satellite imagery from 90+ satellites with image resolutions ranging from 30cm to 1m. 15 minutes revisit with submeter resolution optical satellites. Tri-stereo imaging, True-color night imaging, Hyperspectral imagery, Video and C-Band and L-Band SAR data.

Name: Singapore Space Network (SGSN)
Description: Singapore Space Network (SGSN) is a community for professionals in the space industry who are based out of Singapore, or are associated with Singapore

Name: Lambdai Space
Description:
Lambdai Space aims to bridge the gap between Earth observation and cutting-edge technology. By harnessing advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques, combined with a rich array of satellite radar imagery, we aspire to shift the paradigm from rudimentary X-rays to the precision and depth of MRI in healthcare.
This data-driven revolution empowers industries with physic-aware machine learning models, unlocking a trove of untapped information to fuel data-driven decision-making and transformative solutions. Through our innovative approach, we seek to propel Earth observation into a new era, ushering in unprecedented opportunities for businesses, researchers, and global stakeholders alike. Together, we will reshape industries by harnessing the true potential of Earth observation data.

Name: OculloSpace
Description: OculloSpace is a space education and innovation company dedicated to empowering the next generation of space technologists in ASEAN while delivering cost-effective satellite and orbital solutions for real-world applications. Through project-based learning, our flagship collaboration with NASA HUNCH, and partnerships with agencies such as MYSA and OSTIn, we integrate space education into national systems to cultivate future explorers. Our initiatives include CubeSat programs, sounding rockets, IoT connectivity, and the flagship “ElephantJuice” mission, which inspires public engagement by creating human legacies in orbit. With a dual focus on talent development and innovation, OculloSpace strengthens ASEAN’s role in the global space ecosystem.

Name: Vestion
Description:
Vestion is poised to revolutionize space access with the development, deployment, and operation of the world's first operational orbital tether, enabled by breakthrough advancements in carbon nanotube (CNT) composite materials. Current space access is characterized by prohibitive costs, limited payload capacities, and environmental concerns associated with traditional rocket launches. Our orbital tether offers a transformative solution, promising orders of magnitude reduction in launch costs, increased payload throughput, and a gentle, sustainable pathway to orbit.

Leveraging proprietary CNT manufacturing and integration techniques, Vestion will construct a terrestrial (or high-altitude platform) to Geosynchronous Earth Orbit (GEO) tether, serving as the foundational infrastructure for a new era of space exploration, industrialization, and tourism. The initial target market includes satellite operators, space agencies, and emerging in-space manufacturing companies, with future expansion into space tourism and resource extraction.

Name: Fydemy

Name: SATORO Space
Description:
SATORO PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based CubeSat integrator that has guided multiple customers to successful in-orbit demonstrations (IOD).
We deliver fast and reliable access to space through our flight-proven CubeSat bus platform and standardized AIT process.
Our mission is to help customers achieve successful, on-orbit results through IOD/IOV services, satellite operations, and launch integration.

Name: Space Armour
Description:
Space Armour is a SpaceTech venture pioneering sovereign agentic AI infrastructure for space — enabling secure, autonomous, and verifiable operations in orbit. Our core platform combines onboard intelligence, cryptographic integrity, and Zero Trust security into a single stack powering AI-enabled satellites, orbital systems, and next-generation space infrastructure.

The same space-grade architecture also extends to enterprise edge and mission-critical environments, where reliability, security, and sovereign control of AI are essential.

Space Armour is a UK Space Agency accelerator alumnus, NVIDIA Inception member, Google Cloud technology partner, and part of the SSTL ecosystem.

[Note: Not all team members are on LinkedIn]

Name: ATLANTIS SPACE CITY
Description:
Atlantis is humanity’s first city in space, designed to unite like-minded travelers and adventurers in an extraordinary journey beyond Earth. It offers a seamless fusion of community and cutting-edge technology, creating a space where individuals can feel whole as they shape their future in orbit.

It’s not just a destination—it’s a groundbreaking movement that redefines exploration, connection, and possibility.

Name: SEDS Singapore Rocketry Club
Description:
The SEDS Singapore Rocketry Club (SSRC) is the flagship national engineering project run by students from NTU, NUS, SUTD and UiTM.

We aim to design, build, test and fly a high-power chemical rocket with the ultimate goal of delivering payloads to space.

Name: Marble Blue
Description:
Marble Blue helps people see differently and act with purpose.

We bring the Overview Effect down to Earth through immersive VR and guided workshops that spark a powerful shift in perspective: from disconnection to clarity, from isolation to shared responsibility.

Inspired by the awe astronauts feel when seeing Earth from space, our experience invites participants to step back, zoom out, and reconnect with what truly matters - whether that’s the planet, each other, or their own purpose in a larger system.

We work with organisations, schools, and communities across Asia to create space for reflection, alignment, and meaningful change. Whether you're driving sustainability, rethinking leadership, or building stronger communities, Marble Blue helps people start from the inside out.

Because before strategy lands, perspective must shift.

See the Bigger Picture with Marble Blue.
